# Changelog

## 1.1.0 (2026-08-30)

- Added reusable Measure and Learn stage blueprints.
- Added an 80% default quality gate with acceptance-criteria enforcement.
- Added correction routing, blocked and paused run states, and resume guidance.
- Updated setup, validation, and portable workspace templates.

## 1.0.0 (2026-08-29)

- Initial portable release from `workspaces/alson-workspace-template`
- Workspace setup workflow with destination confirmation and validation
- Five-layer context architecture and selective loading guidance
- Explicit composable stage contract guidance
- Bundled workspace skeleton, configuration templates, setup materials, and stage template
